incidente.resumo: On October 27, 2021, Twilio reported high filtering on SMS towards the AT&T network in the United States, affecting long code, short code and toll-free SMS. Engineers worked with the carrier partner; the text does not say what caused the filtering or what was done to restore service, only that recovery was observed and the incident was marked resolved at 14:24 PDT.

descricao.texto: The first update reports high filtering on SMS towards the AT&T network in the United States.
trechos: We are experiencing high filtering on SMS towards AT&T network in Unites states.

observacoes: The document is a sequence of status updates with no post-mortem. Engineers were working with the carrier partner to resolve the issue, but no action taken is described. The impact start time is not stated (the first update was posted at 05:47 PDT); recovery for short codes and long codes was reported at 09:18 PDT with increased filtering continuing for toll-free, and the incident was marked resolved at 14:24 PDT, so duracao is null.
